shortDescription: Manages Out-Of-Band controllers using Open Composable API (OCAPI)

options.name: category
options.description: Category to execute on OOB controller.

options.name: command
options.description: Command to execute on OOB controller.

options.name: job_name
options.description: For O(command=DeleteJob) command, the name of the job to delete.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: proxy_slot_number
options.description: For proxied inband requests, the slot number of the IOM. Only applies if O(baseuri) is a proxy server.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for URL requests to OOB controller.

options.name: update_image_path
options.description: For O(command=FWUpload), the path on the local filesystem of the firmware update image.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for authenticating to OOB controller.
